description: What a human service order would cost, free: our count ("70 words, English to Turkish", "40 lines of code"), price_cents, the promise, daily_limit (whether it fits what is left of your owner's limit today, or needs their approval by email) and a signed quote (quote_jws, valid 24 hours).
